BL-696 — Console Mini App Let's Talk — discrete audio turns with the Cursor agent over the existing bridge session
What it solves: Specifier drained 2026-07-27 from operator intake. Feature lint-clean at
materialization. Step handlers land with the coder parcel (BL-233).
Approval context: Discrete turn-taking only (record → STT → Cursor agent → TTS → next turn). Live duplex, streaming STT, open-mic, and WebRTC are explicitly rejected for v1. The Mini App shares the default Cursor Remote agent session; a visible New session control is the only way to fork. Text Cursor Remote and Conc…
